analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 28.3, entering oversold territory, with 5 consecutive days of decline. ADX at 23.4, in early trend formation stage, but -DI is dominant over +DI. MACD histogram continues to worsen. 5-day low matches 20-day low, but 5-day high is lower, forming a Lower High pattern. Current price $58.65 is near swing support at $57.54. Setting stop loss at 1.3x ATR ($2.14) yields $56.18, and target at $60.80. Risk/reward ratio below 1.5.
